m_26_14.description: MAC OUI (Organizationally Unique Identifier) → vendor + device_class catalog. Enrich source index for the m_26_14-oui-vendor enrich policy used by the m_26_14-network-device-normalize pipeline. One doc per 24-bit OUI prefix (lowercase colon form, e.g. 00:1d:9c). ot=true flags industrial/ICS/BMS vendors. Starter set — replace/extend with your agency's OT/IoT vendor inventory or a full IEEE OUI export.
